deductions.reason: BrowserWindow lacks acceptFirstMouse; first click on an inactive card only activates the window, swallowing button presses (observed live: expand clicks required a second click).
Every refresh spams the log with the pg sslmode deprecation warning; main paths are not clean-log.
Cards clamp at maxHeight 300 with overflow hidden; expanded text longer than the window is silently truncated with no scroll affordance.
No screen.on('display-added'/'display-removed'/'display-metrics-changed') listeners; unplugging or rearranging monitors strands the column until an unrelated relayout fires.
Layout engine, tray menu, edge guard, markdown viewer, and IPC handlers all in one file; approaching god-file.
No types or JSDoc anywhere; the note object's shape (14+ optional fields) is implicit across main.js, store.js, ingest.js, note.js.
Corrupt store JSON is silently discarded, wiping positions/dismissals with no backup; openViewer's bare catch hides read failures.
start.sh still documents the retired kill-and-npm-start flow, contradicting the launcher; keychainService/envFile duplicated across three config blocks.
Deadline editor swaps to an unstyled native date input; clipped cards give no visual cue that content continues.
No feedback states: 15-min refresh gives no indicator, and ✓ on DB-backed cards (1-2s write) shows nothing pending and doesn't guard against double-click.
Synchronous full-store disk write on every layout pass, including every coalesced wheel tick while scrolling — hot-path sync I/O.
Spawns an osascript subprocess every 1.2s all day even when the frontmost window hasn't changed.
The three Neon sources each open/close their own connection and run sequentially — a fetch waterfall that should be parallel.
Nothing is keyboard-operable: no shortcuts for close/done/expand, contenteditable region unlabeled, focus never visible.
8px uppercase chips are borderline legible; emoji-only pin/close buttons have title tooltips but no accessible names.
marked output injected unsanitized into a data: URL with no CSP; script tags in a source markdown file would execute in the viewer window.
Still one file for layout, tray, guard, viewer, IPC; splitting into layout.js / tray.js / viewer.js remains the right structure move.
Note/IngestResult typedefs now exist but individual functions in main.js/store.js are still unannotated; the contract lives in one file, not at the call sites.
Deadline editor still swaps to an unstyled native date input that visually clashes with the card.

Edge guard still spawns an osascript subprocess every 1.2s while notes are pinned; event-driven detection isn't possible without native helpers, but the interval could back off when the frontmost app hasn't changed.
Still no keyboard operability: no shortcuts for close/done/expand/step, and cards can't be tabbed between.
Shortcuts operate the active card, but reaching a card still requires a mouse click — there is no keyboard way to move focus between cards.
